description: Search World Bank development projects by free text and/or country and status. Returns financing, sectors, lending instrument, approval/closing dates, and status for each match. Keyless. Provide query and/or country_code.

country_code.description: ISO-2 country code to filter by, e.g. "BR" (Brazil), "KE" (Kenya), "IN" (India).

query.description: Free-text search, e.g. "rural water supply", "climate resilience", "rural electrification".

name: search_projects
title: Search Projects
